---
title: "German RSE Survey Books"
---

Each survey year focuses only on respondents working in Germany and is
presented independently using the questions and answer options contained in
that year's dataset. No cross-year harmonisation is applied.

## Survey years in this publication

- [2017 Germany survey](2017/)
- [2018 Germany survey](2018/)
- [2022 Germany survey](2022/)
- [2026 Germany survey](2026/)

The four years are assembled into one publication. Choose a year from the page
header; the left sidebar will then show only that year's thematic question
sections and questions. The page-level table of contents on the right is
disabled.

The 2016 export contains only United Kingdom respondents, so it is not included
in this Germany-focused publication. All results are generated dynamically from
the corresponding response and question-metadata files. The country is
configurable, so the same process can produce a combined publication for other
countries represented in the selected years.

Generic books include submitted and partial records, and each question reports
how many of each provided an answer.
